text: are you saying there is a store.db for the texture to be stored in but its not there for any of them
resolution: Same change as req_1667 (these captured the same conversation thread): added a 'load from prop' picker to the Studio paint toolbar that pulls a compiled prop's content-addressed texture blob back onto the open model, making painting recoverable rather than one-shot. The compiled prop is the durable texture backup because the cooked-asset store never GCs blobs while the model stream does (req_1556). Implemented in cart/hmsc-int/editors/model/studiokit/StudioViewport.tsx (loadPaintFromAsset + picker modal), paired with display fix 47e9736e5 so reopened painted models show their paint in any mode.
